fields.System.Title: INT-505 — Stale projections
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want to know when a projection has stopped updating, so that frozen
data is not served confidently as current.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given each projection, then the age of its newest row is monitored — not merely
  • whether the job ran.
  • - Given an age beyond that projection's freshness threshold, then an alert is raised.
  • - Given a projection whose update path has silently stopped, then it is detected even
  • though every row still looks valid.
  • - Given the report, then it covers proxy tables and any external-system copies as well
  • as internal projections.
  • - Given an alert, then it names the projection, its age, and the rebuild job that would
  • fix it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | all projections |
| Risks | Sync silently stopped, serving frozen data ([doc 08 §4](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
